body:
Oh, it's because `packages/upgrade/static/src` is a linux-style symlink to `packages/upgrade/src`. Windows doesn't recognize it and can't find `downgrade_module.ts`.

There are some scripts in `scripts/windows/` which you can use to update/restore those symlinks (require admin rights, if you haven't enabled Windows dev mode).

We should probably document that, though (or somehow automate it).
(Or even better get rid of the symlink :wink:)
Would one of you be interested in adding a note in `aio/README.md`? 🙏

@gkalpak Thanks for the reply! I executed the "remove-symlinks.sh"  first and then "create-symlinks.sh" in angular/scripts/windows as a Admin and now I can execute "yarn setup" without any problems.

I will create a PR with a note in aio/README.md!
